destinies.doom: The Seer speaks at the coming of age.

destinies.prophecy: Fire will be the end of you.
destinies.doom: Doom: a failed Fire quest kills.
destinies.gift: Gift: nothing else can. Not wounds, not age.

destinies.prophecy: You will outlive those you love.
destinies.doom: Doom: every grief strikes 2 dread deeper.
destinies.gift: Gift: old age comes half as often.
destinies.doom_template: Doom: every grief strikes % dread deeper.

destinies.doom: Doom: a triumph at Court, at 8 renown, takes them.
destinies.gift: Gift: a patron after. +1 on every quest.
destinies.doom_template: Doom: a triumph at Court, at % renown, takes them.
destinies.gift_template: Gift: a patron after. +% on every quest.

destinies.prophecy: You will open the Sealed Door.
destinies.doom: Doom: if they die, it falls to their firstborn.
destinies.gift: Gift: +5 at every lock of the Door.
destinies.gift_template: Gift: +% at every lock of the Door.

destinies.doom: Doom: once the firstborn is of age, they learn no more.
destinies.gift: Gift: the firstborn is born with +2 in all.
destinies.gift_template: Gift: the firstborn is born with +% in all.

destinies.prophecy: You will break and be mended.
destinies.doom: Doom: the first disaster wounds, and brings 2 dread.
destinies.gift: Gift: it cannot kill. +1 in all after.
destinies.doom_template: Doom: the first disaster wounds, and brings % dread.
destinies.gift_template: Gift: it cannot kill. +% in all after.

destinies.prophecy: You will die in your bed.
destinies.doom: Doom: old age comes twice as often.
destinies.gift: Gift: no quest can kill. Not a disaster, not a wound.

destinies.doom: Doom: when they die the house loses 4 renown.
destinies.gift: Gift: +1 renown from every quest they win.
destinies.doom_template: Doom: when they die the house loses % renown.
destinies.gift_template: Gift: +% renown from every quest they win.

destinies.prophecy: You will teach a greater than yourself.
destinies.doom: Doom: they learn nothing more themselves.
destinies.gift: Gift: those they teach learn 1 more, and may pass them.
destinies.gift_template: Gift: those they teach learn % more, and may pass them.
